Ellen Park: OK team, quick follow-up to the multi-region RFC: can we explore a consent-aware "slice and spill" model to reduce full failovers?
Diego M.: Define slice-and-spill please.
Ellen Park: Each region maintains a resident slice (guaranteed). When load exceeds resident slice, requests with tenant consent can spill to a global spill pool. Spill is preemptible and subject to eviction rules. No tenant with REGION_ONLY consent spills.
Samir Rao: Main concerns: KV ownership, tail-latency when transferring, and preventing eviction storms.
Ellen Park: Proposed eviction rules: 1) never preempt kv_owner jobs without lease token handshake; 2) prefer stateless or cached-prefix jobs for spill; 3) cap preemptions to N per minute per region.
Diego M.: Handshake sketch: preemptor sends PREEMPT_REQUEST, running worker replies PREEMPT_SAFE_POINT when able, preemptor attempts cold-start with kv warmup estimate. If no safe-point within timeout, abort preemption.
Samir Rao: Metrics to add: spill.allocations, spill.preempt_timeout_count, spill.kv_handoff_ms, spill.denied_due_to_consent. Also an alert if preempt_timeout_count > 5% over 10m.
infra-bot: Deployed canary: slice-spill-v1 -> us-east-1 (canary=3%). Logs: 'slice-spill:init ok'
Ellen Park: Proxy change: add header 'X-Tenant-Consent: region_only|preferred'. Proxy reads tenant metadata cache and tags requests.
Diego M.: Routing policy snippet idea: match resident=true -> region_slice; match consent=preferred & region_full -> spill_pool; fallback -> enqueue or degrade.
Samir Rao: Test plan: synthetic hotspot across eu-west and us-east with mixed consent tenants. Measure p95/p99 tail under 0, 30, and 60s preempt timeouts.
Ellen Park: Action items: Diego -> implement proxy header + metadata flag; Samir -> design handshake and metrics; I'll own perf test. Follow-up sync in 48h.
Ellen Park: If this reduces cross-region headroom exhaustion we can avoid many noisy failovers.
